summary.name: WeblogMatrix
summary.one_liner: A website that lets you compare features of different blog software side by side in a table to help choose one.
use_cases: comparing blog software before choosing one
finding a blog platform with specific features
filtering blog engines by required features
summary.what_it_does: The site provides a comparison tool where you select several blog software packages and view their features in a side-by-side table. You can narrow the available options with a filter. A search function lets you configure the specific features you need in a blog. The page is listed in awesome-selfhosted under Blogging Platforms as a related resource. The page text does not name the individual blog packages it covers.
notable: Side-by-side feature comparison tables for blog software
Filter and feature search to narrow options
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under Blogging Platforms
caveats: The page text does not state pricing or licensing terms
The page text does not list which blog packages are included
